items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s for your guy, with your best friend, with Wayne Shorter on stage, in front of people who care

ctx.x: Yeah. Savor this moment. It’s for your guy, with your best friend, with Wayne Shorter on stage, in front of people who care, and paid well, and I’m standing instead of lying. That was a great moment, one of the great ones.

I should tell you. When I was 16, I found an E-flat sopranino saxophone in the back of a music store, bought it, started playing it, and played it for a number of years. Then, after playing that for about 7 or 8 years, then I bought the Couf soprano that I still play.
